in_marathi.name: Ambarika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ambarika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ambarika is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'ambara' meaning 'sky' or 'heavens'. In Hindu mythology, Ambarika is the name of a sage who is said to have gained immortality by offering the sacred 'amrita' to the gods. The name is considered auspicious and is often given to boys in Hindu communities.
